subject.title: feat: version field in health response + POST /admin/update endpoint

question: Should OpenClaw expose package-update execution through the gateway Admin HTTP API, or should update orchestration remain outside the HTTP gateway until the external updater design is settled?
rationale: The endpoint would convert an existing local package-manager operation into a remotely triggerable host-level action, which is a product and security-boundary choice rather than a mechanical gateway route addition.

options.title: Split and defer update endpoint
options.body: Land only a narrow version-observability contract through the canonical health issue and defer HTTP update execution until updater ownership and authorization are designed.

options.title: Design authenticated admin update API
options.body: Sponsor a security-reviewed Admin API design that specifies allowed callers, package managers, audit logs, rollback behavior, and tests before any implementation PR.

options.title: Keep updates outside gateway HTTP
options.body: Reject the HTTP update endpoint and document external fleet tools or local CLI/update primitives as the supported orchestration path.

recommendation.title: Split and defer update endpoint
recommendation.body: Land only a narrow version-observability contract through the canonical health issue and defer HTTP update execution until updater ownership and authorization are designed.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent git history ties this identity to the gateway/admin/update surfaces that would need to own the final API and security-boundary direction.
